title: Booking.com Hotel Search & Details Scraper
description: Search Booking.com or load hotel URLs, then collect prices, rooms, ratings, amenities, photos and policies for your travel dates.

mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Search a destination, or load specific Booking.com hotel URLs.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: City, region or landmark to search, e.g. Paris, New York or Tokyo. Required in search mode.

startUrls.title: Hotel URLs
startUrls.description: Booking.com hotel page URLs, used in details mode. Copy links from a search result or your browser.

checkIn.title: Check-in date
checkIn.description: Check-in date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use tomorrow.

checkOut.title: Check-out date
checkOut.description: Check-out date as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use a 3-night stay.

propertyType.title: Property type
propertyType.description: Keep only one Booking.com property type, or search all types.

minReviewScore.title: Minimum review score
minReviewScore.description: Minimum guest score from 0 to 10. The actor applies Booking.com's score filter and then keeps only properties at or above this exact score.

stars.title: Stars
stars.description: Keep only properties with this star rating, or any star rating.

freeCancellation.title: Free cancellation only
freeCancellation.description: Return properties with at least one free-cancellation rate.

breakfast.title: Breakfast included only
breakfast.description: Return properties with a breakfast-included rate.

pool.title: Swimming pool only
pool.description: Return properties that have a swimming pool.

minPrice.title: Minimum price per night
minPrice.description: Optional lower bound for the nightly price in the chosen currency.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price per night
maxPrice.description: Optional upper bound for the nightly price in the chosen currency.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code such as USD, EUR or GBP.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language Booking.com should use for the pages.

includeRooms.title: Include room types
includeRooms.description: Add the room and rate table for each hotel. Turn off for a smaller, faster dataset.

includeFullAmenities.title: Include full amenity list
includeFullAmenities.description: Render each hotel page in a browser to collect the complete facility list. Slower and only needed when you want every amenity.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Booking.com uses an AWS WAF challenge. Apify's AUTO proxy is prefilled; the actor uses this proxy for browser and HTTP requests.
